name: SwingHighProfitTarget
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), profitThreshold) && haveHi && el_ge(high[0], swHiPx + offsetTicks * tickSz)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), profitThreshold) && haveLo && el_le(low[0], swLoPx - offsetTicks * tickSz)
